values.note: Morton County: electrical sites $25 a night (up to two campers per pedestal, each $25); primitive (no pad, no power) $15; group pads $100 a night for five campers. Pay the camp host or the iron ranger at the entrance. Undated county FAQ, read 2026-11-12.

fees.source: https://www.mortonnd.gov/parksfaq ('Electrical sites are $25/night. Primitive camping sites are $15/night.'; 'You can pay the Camp Host, or the Iron Ranger located at the entrance of the campground.'; 'The group pads can be reserved for $100/night'), read 2026-11-12

values.note: Every pedestal has 50, 30 and 20 amp; no site has water (fill at the spigot by the camp host).

hookups.source: https://www.mortonnd.gov/parksfaq ('Each of our pedestals have a 50, 30 and 20 amp in them... Harmon Lake – 43'; 'No campsites have water. At Harmon Lake there is a spigot by the Camp Host to fill your tanks.'), read 2026-11-12

values.note: 43 electric sites plus two reservable group pads and open primitive camping.

sites.source: https://www.mortonnd.gov/harmonlake ('43 Electrical Camping Sites', 'Primitive Camping'); https://www.mortonnd.gov/parksfaq ('Harmon Lake has two group pads'), read 2026-11-12

facilities.source: https://www.mortonnd.gov/harmonlake ('3 Vault Toilets', 'Potable Water', 'Camper Dumping Station'), read 2026-11-12

values.note: Only the two group pads can be reserved, by phone with the County Parks office.

booking.source: https://www.mortonnd.gov/parksfaq ('Group sites can be reserved. Call the County Parks office at 701-667-3363 to check availability. Individual sites are first come, first serve.'; 'Camping is allowed for 10 consecutive days.'), read 2026-11-12

note: Morton County recreation area on Harmon Lake, about 8 mi north of Mandan off Hwy 1806 and County Road 140; paved access, camp host, storm shelter, boat ramp with dock, kayak dock, floating fishing pier, sandy swim beach and a 19-mile biking and hiking trail. --Claude
summary: County page + parks FAQ: 43 electric sites (50/30/20 amp pedestals), no water at sites, $25/night ($15 primitive), FCFS (only 2 group pads reservable), 10-day limit, vault toilets, dump. Corrected hookups.water true->false and booking to FCFS. Lakeview confirmed on imagery. Pin OK.
flags: WATERFRONT (lakeview stands, no change): the herringbone RV rows sit on an open grassy rise about 150-350 m north of the shore; nearest pads (around 46.9425,-100.9680) are ~150 m from the west arm over open grass, with the campground's own loop road and the day-use beach and ball field between. Lake in plain view, no site within ~50 m, so no upgrade.
Phone (701) 667-3363 confirmed (Park Manager and Parks Director). Website https://www.mortonnd.gov/harmonlake confirmed.
